description: Weekly refresh of the digests pinned in image/pins.env, which is how Fedora's updates reach OrielOS builds. OrielOS keeps its own copy of every pinned digest (the Mirror workflow), so an older pin keeps building. GitHub Actions and the Discord bot's packages are left to Dependabot.

customManagers.description: Container images in image/pins.env, pinned as name:tag@sha256:digest

packageRules.description: Refresh the digests together, in one pull request: the two akmods images must match the same kernel. It waits for the maintainer, who builds and boot-tests it locally before merging. Merging it doesn't publish a build: the new digests go out with the next change to OrielOS itself, or a run of the Image workflow by hand.
prBodyNotes: Build and boot-test this locally before merging: `tools/build-image.sh`, then the VM tests. Merging it doesn't publish a build by itself; the new digests go out with the next build.

packageRules.description: A new Fedora release changes the tags; that move is planned separately, not proposed here.
